summary.en: Where groups overlap, the subset squares shrink into a vertical axis and the rest drop away; one bar per series grows out of that axis, the protagonist in the accent.
summary.zh: 组别重叠时，子集的方块缩成一根竖轴，其余方块落下淡出；每个系列从这根轴长出一根条，主角用强调色。

fits: The surprise of a counted story: tags that overlap (one item can name several), drawn as bars on the subset itself.
notFor: Groups that do not overlap (unit-bands keeps the squares as the bars); more than 8 series.

intent.en: Overlap becomes a surprise you can see: the subset shrinks into an axis and bars grow out of it, so one item naming several things is shown, not claimed.
intent.zh: 重叠变成看得见的意外：子集缩成一根轴，条从轴上长出来，一件东西同时属于几类是画出来的，不是说出来的。

content.en: Series (2–8, name ≤ 14 / 6 字, count, may overlap), the subset size, a title (≤ 44 / 16 字), a sub (≤ 8 words / 16 字).
content.zh: 系列（2–8 个，名称 ≤ 14 字符 / 6 字，数量，可重叠），子集大小，标题（≤ 44 / 16 字），副标题（≤ 8 词 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 计数故事里的意外：互相重叠的标签（一件可以属于几类），画成子集本身上的条。

notFor.zh: 不重叠的分组（unit-bands 直接用方块当条）；超过 8 个系列。

en: Say in the sub that one item can count in several bars, or the bars read as an error.
zh: 副标题要说明一件可以计入几条，否则条长加起来像错的。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
